tha-ap523:1.1: himavantassāvidūre → himavantassa avidūre (bj); paṭhamaṁ tiṇamuṭṭhidāyakattherāpadānaṁ himavantassa avidūre (sya-all)
tha-ap523:1.3: tattheva tisso → tatthopatisso (bj) | tatthopatisso → tattheva tisso (bj: machasaṁ) | tisso → tatthopatisso (cck: sī. pī. ka.)
tha-ap523:4.1: gatamattassa → gatamattaṁ maṁ (sya-all) | maṁ → aciraṁgatamattassa (bj: machasaṁ) | gatamattassa → gatamattaṁ maṁ (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap523:4.2: apothayi → aheṭhayi (sya-all) | aheṭhayi → apothayī (bj: machasaṁ) | apothayi → aheṭhayi (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
tha-ap523:4.3: pothito → ghāṭito (sya-all) | pātito → pothito (bj: machasaṁ) | pothito → pātito (cck: sī. pī.); ghāṭito (cck: syā.)
tha-ap523:5.4: devalokamagañchahaṁ → devalokaṁ agacchahaṁ (bj); devalokamagacchahaṁ (cck); devalokaṁ agañchahaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap523:9.4: tiṇamuṭṭhe idaṁ → tiṇamuṭṭhimhidaṁ (bj) | phalaṁ → tiṇamuṭṭhe idaṁ phalaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
